{"title":"Alleged Plagiarism in an Original Commissioned Article","description":"This dispute concerns a commissioned writing service.
The buyer requested an original article and specified that the work must not reproduce copyrighted or substantially similar text from existing publications without authorization.
The seller accepted the request and delivered an article.
After delivery, the buyer conducted an originality review and submitted evidence claiming that significant portions of the delivered article reproduce language from a previously published third-party article.
The seller disputes this characterization and argues that similarities concern common facts, concepts, and expressions rather than impermissible copying.
Jurors must evaluate the buyer's request, the seller's accepted terms, the delivered work, the alleged source material, the parties' arguments, and the applicable policy.","question":"Did the seller's delivered work substantially comply with the buyer's requirement to provide original commissioned content?","category":"Agentic Commerce","answers":[{"title":"Refund the buyer","id":"0x1","description":"Select this option when the evidence establishes that the seller materially failed to provide the original work required by the agreement."},{"title":"Pay the seller","id":"0x2","description":"Select this option when the delivered work substantially complies with the agreed requirements or when the available evidence does not establish a material originality violation."}],"version":"1.0","policyURI":"/ipfs/QmaVHepy3cgCWLCLRDbB2wwD1fxFFJFCSBWmos8etz8h2z","arbitratorAddress":"0x991d2df165670b9cac3B022f4B68D65b664222ea","arbitratorChainID":"42161"}

{"title":"¿Es válido el reclamo?","description":""Los jurados deben elegir una de las siguientes opciones al resolver el caso:

Aceptar el Reclamo

Seleccionar esta opción cuando el reclamo del consumidor resulte procedente al menos parcialmente, y al menos contra uno de los proveedores demandados. Esta opción debe seleccionarse independientemente de que:

El monto de compensación reclamado por el consumidor sea considerado excesivo. Alguno de los demandados no resulte responsable. Algún rubro/concepto reclamado en particular no sea procedente. En tales casos, la justificación debe indicar:

Si considera excesivo el monto reclamado y por qué. Si la demanda no procede frente a alguno de los demandados y sus razones. Si algún rubro/concepto reclamado no procede y por qué.

Rechazar el Reclamo

Seleccionar esta opción cuando el reclamo del consumidor no resulte procedente o no existan pruebas suficientes para sustentarlo.

{"title":"Will Zelenskyy wear a suit before July? - Is a black tailored jacket-and-trousers ensemble a \"suit\"?","description":"The market pays out if Zelenskyy is photographed in a suit before July 2025. At the NATO summit in The Hague he appeared in a matching all-black tailored jacket and trousers with no tie, and credible outlets described the look in conflicting terms. Market: \"Will Zelenskyy wear a suit before July?\" (Polymarket, slug will-zelenskyy-wear-a-suit-before-july). Two questions are entangled. First, ordinary meaning: does a matching tailored jacket and trousers, worn without a tie or a conventional dress shirt, count as a 'suit'? Second, evidentiary standard: the market resolves on 'a consensus of credible reporting', and the reporting that exists is hedged and divided rather than uniform. The case file ends at the challenge; no other forum's view of the question has authority here.
